metadata.title: Srinagar Food Tour, Part - 1/3 I Kashmiri Cuisine
metadata.description:
Kashmir's Wazwan is famous all over the world but besides Wazwan there are a lot more food option you can explore when in Kashmir.

In this video we are going to take you on an exclusive food journey of this beautiful valley. From the world famous wazwan to the local everyday food, it is going to be a journey of a lifetime.


About the host- Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!
